summary: Vendored the exact `ask_user` Pi extension into the repo as a first-party capability that ships with every Gizmo install. Canonical source lives at `pi-extensions/ask-user.ts`, embedded into the compiled sidecar via a generated source module, and seeded to the data dir at startup so Pi loads it like any other extension; precedence puts shipped copies after the user's agent-dir extensions.
decisions: Vendor the exact `ask_user` extension (TUI popup + bridge path + tool-call renderers) as a plain Pi extension with no Gizmo-specific code — matches the 'UI ships with the extension' model.

Embed extension source as a string in the agent-server build (since the compiled bun sidecar has no repo files on disk) and seed to the data dir at startup, overwriting only when stale; works in both dev (tsx) and compiled binary modes.
Load shipped Pi extensions *after* the user's agent-dir extensions so a same-named extension in `~/.pi/agent/extensions/` takes precedence.
Use a `pi-extensions/` directory at the repo root as the canonical home for capabilities that ship with every Gizmo install, regenerated via `pnpm extensions:generate`.

Pi aliases `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`, `@earendil-works/pi-tui`, and `typebox` itself in its loader, so the seeded extension file requires no node_modules of its own — confirming the embed+seed approach is viable.
errors: `tsx scripts/generate-pi-extension-source.ts` failed with esbuild error: 'Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output format' — script uses top-level await and tsx defaulted to CJS.

svelte-check failed in `apps/app` after changes: `Property 'options' does not exist` on the union of select/confirm/editor in `PiExtensionQuestion.svelte` — TS didn't narrow the union across `||`; fixed by computing `acceptsText` with explicit `method === 'select'` branch and adding an early-return guard in `submitText` before accessing `request.options`.

Seed test failed with ENOENT when trying to write a stale seeded file — `pi-extensions/` subdir didn't exist under the temp data dir; fixed by adding `mkdir(join(dataDir, 'pi-extensions'), { recursive: true })` before writing.
